[RHIM.5.1.2] Before dispatching a hydration call to the adapter, the engine must
count the working-memory facts of hydration targets whose `corr` is non-empty. When that count
has reached the budget, the engine must reject the call: it must assert a
`CallError` with `code` set to `"budget_exhausted"` for the call's correlation,
and must not dispatch the call to the adapter.
